blocks.text: Sulfur is used as a cross-linker for rubber molecular chains; this is vulcanisation, and it improves the strength of rubber (Figure 12.10: S-S cross-links between polymer chains).

blocks.alt: Two panels of wavy orange rubber polymer chains. Before vulcanisation the three chains are separate and can slide past each other. After vulcanisation short S-S bridges join neighbouring chains at several points, tying them together; the note says the sulfur cross-links make the rubber stronger.
blocks.caption: S-S cross-linkages (original diagram after Figure 12.10).
